name: Hecarim
title: the Shadow of War

Q.name: Rampage
Q.description: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies for 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.9×bonus AD physical damage. If this Ability hits, he gains a stack that decreases its Cooldown by 0.75 seconds and increases its damage by 3 + 0.03×bonus AD% for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
Q.summary: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages.

W.name: Spirit of Dread
W.description: Hecarim deals 80/120/160/200/240 + 0.8×AP magic damage over 4 seconds to nearby enemies. Hecarim gains 5/10/15/20/25 Armor and Magic Resist and heals for 25% of damage nearby enemies take from Hecarim and (25) × 0.5% of damage taken from his allies.
W.summary: Hecarim gains Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and gains Health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.

E.name: Devastating Charge
E.description: Hecarim becomes Ghosted and gains 25% Move Speed increasing to 65% over 4 seconds. His next Attack Knocks Back and deals between 30/45/60/75/90 + 0.5×bonus AD and (30/45/60/75/90 + 0.5×bonus AD) × 2 physical damage. Knock Back distance and damage scales with distance travelled during this Ability.
E.summary: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.

R.name: Onslaught of Shadows
R.description: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing 150/250/350 + 1×AP magic damage. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that Fears for between 0.75 to 1.5 seconds, increased by charge distance.
R.summary: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.

Passive.name: Warpath
Passive.description: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.
Passive.summary: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Hecarim is a fast-moving fighter jungler who turns move speed into damage through Warpath. He ganks from far away with Devastating Charge and starts teamfights with Onslaught of Shadows, a charge that fears.
strengths: Devastating Charge gives Ghosted move speed that ramps up, then knocks back on his next attack, making long-range ganks easy.
Warpath turns bonus move speed into attack damage, so speed items give him damage too.
Onslaught of Shadows charges through the enemy team and fears everyone at the end, longer the farther he charged.
Very fast clear with Rampage stacks and Spirit of Dread's healing.
Spirit of Dread heals him from damage nearby enemies take, even from allies.
weaknesses: Mana-hungry early: spamming Q runs him dry.
No hard CC apart from E's knock-back and R's fear.
Kited by slows: they cut both his speed and his damage.
E's charge is predictable; enemies see him coming.
Grievous Wounds cuts the healing from W.

curve.lvl1: okay – Q and W clear fast but he lacks CC
curve.lvl2: okay – Q stacks, W heal, but no gank tool
curve.lvl3: strong – E Devastating Charge gives long-range ganks
curve.lvl6: very strong – Onslaught of Shadows starts teamfights
curve.items: strong – first item: Trinity Force or Eclipse, then Sundered Sky; speed items add damage
curve.late: good – stays a strong engage fighter

profile.curveNote: Hecarim wants E to gank, so he waits for level 3. His teamfight power comes at 6 with Onslaught of Shadows.
profile.waveClear: Very good: Q hits whole camps and waves.
profile.sustain: Good: W heals from damage taken by nearby enemies.
profile.mobility: High: E Ghosted move speed and R charge.

keyAbilities.engage: R (Onslaught of Shadows) to fear the team
keyAbilities.escape: E (Devastating Charge) move speed to escape
keyAbilities.answers: None. Hecarim has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Warpath: gains attack damage from bonus move speed. Slows reduce his damage.

Q.notes: Rampage: a cleave that stacks for more damage and lower cooldown.

W.notes: Spirit of Dread: damage around him over time, armor, magic resist and healing.

E.answer: Jax E dodges; Fiora W parries; slows cut his charge.
E.notes: Devastating Charge: Ghosted ramping move speed; next attack knocks back, more with distance.

R.answer: Dodge sideways; Cleanse/QSS removes the fear.
R.notes: Onslaught of Shadows: a charge with damage, ending in a fear that lasts longer with distance.

profile.windowAgainst: Hecarim's window is when E is on cooldown: he has no way to catch you. Slow him to cut his damage and speed.
checks: Does Hecarim use E to gank from long range?
Does Hecarim charge R through the enemy team to fear several targets?
Does the enemy team slow him?
